Enigma.description: Seeker of deep lore, secrets, and answers to the universe's greatest mysteries.

features.name: Enigma Muse
features.tldr: Gain extra trained skills, lore training scaling, and the 'True Strike' or 'Known Weakness' style advantages.

Maestro.description: Master of performance longevity, resonant echoes, and powerful composition scaling.

features.name: Maestro Muse
features.tldr: Extend the duration of your composition spells and gain access to inspiring crescendo effects.

Polymath.description: Jack-of-all-trades versatile scholar who blends arcane flexibility with performance.

features.name: Polymath Muse
features.tldr: Use Performance checks in place of diplomacy and cast spells from magical items or diverse repertoires easier.

Warrior.description: Combative skald blending martial weapons with inspiring battle anthems.

features.name: Warrior Muse
features.tldr: Gain martial weapon proficiency, medium armor training, and fierce martial composition feats.
